files.README.md:
# Meadowbrook Swim Centre - August enrolments export

One row per enrolment taken at the front desk. program is the booked
course exactly as printed on the booking form; fee_gbp is the amount
invoiced when the enrolment was taken.
files.notes/rota.txt:
Lifeguard rota notes
- Lane ropes come out of storage on Friday evenings.
- The training pool closes early on gala days; see the whiteboard.
